title: A-A and C-C pairs at rest, separation 3.0 to 3.5, T <= 1: piecewise-linear K(r) nodes, supersedes P-0014 in that domain

claims.statement: Two A particles at rest, initial separation r0 in [3.0, 3.5], observed for durations up to 1.0: each accelerates toward the other with magnitude K(r)/r^2.5, r the current separation, where K(r) is linear between the nodes K = 16.941 (r = 2.5), 18.034 (r = 3.0), 18.285 (r = 3.5) and held at the end values outside [2.5, 3.5]. Measured positions are predicted to a judged RMSE of 0.007 of the chamber side. Evidence: 2026-11-25/r1/lab-vernier/008-011, all at T = 1 and at separation 3.0 or 3.5. Not claimed: other separations (in particular 2.5, where the pair reaches contact inside T = 1), durations above 1.0, initial velocities, C or mixed pairs, three or more particles, and any shape finer than about 1 to 3 percent in K.

Two C particles at rest, initial separation r0 in [3.0, 3.5], observed for durations up to 1.0: each accelerates toward the other with magnitude K(r)/r^2.5, r the current separation, where K(r) is linear between the nodes K = 12.730 (r = 2.5), 13.202 (r = 3.0), 13.184 (r = 3.5) and held at the end values outside [2.5, 3.5]. Measured positions are predicted to a judged RMSE of 0.007 of the chamber side. Evidence: 2026-11-25/r1/lab-vernier/014-017, all at T = 1 and at separation 3.0 or 3.5. Not claimed: other separations (in particular 2.5), durations above 1.0, initial velocities, A or mixed pairs, three or more particles, and any shape finer than about 1 to 3 percent in K.
